newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index eases as investors sell.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index eases as investors sell.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index eased marginally on Monday as investors unloaded shares into the market, bourse officials said.

The index shed 13.91 points to close at 3447.30. Turnover rose to 66.927 million shillings on 1,853,592 shares from 25.053 million shillings on 737,285 shares on Friday, boosted by heavy foreign investor activity on the three-day offer board.
Brokers said the current trend of easing prices versus heavy turnover would continue as long as local investors offloaded shares to meet demand from foreign institutional investors.
"Special boards will now become a major feature in the market because the big orders are there," a broker said.
Another broker said the increased activity on the special boards had increased the level of liquidity in the market.
Foreigners bought 738,900 shares of Firestone East Africa at between 31.50 and 33 from 33 and 48,600 shares of Kenya Commercial Bank at between 94.50 and 97 from 94.50.
Uchumi Supermarket closed at 42 from 41 while Sasini Tea & Coffee eased to 75 from 75.50.
Prices on the financials board were stable with Barclays Bank firm at 111 from 110. Standard Chartered Bank was unchanged at 46. Diamond Trust Kenya traded 400,608 shares at an unchanged 33.
